name: selectedTab
label: Selected tab
description: Dynamically sets the tab that is open by default when bound to data. For example, use syntax like "@context.props.selectedTab". To set the default tab statically, use the "Default tab" property.

name: selectedTabIndex
label: Selected tab index
description: Dynamically sets the tab that is open by default when bound to data. To set the default tab statically, use the "Default tab" property.

name: tabStyles
label: Tab CSS styles
description: Custom CSS styles applied to the tab bar or the tab container. Use .tabset-tabs and .tabset-container classes to style these regions.

name: maxWidth
label: Maximum width
description: Maximum width (in pixels) of each tab. Text is truncated if it's longer than the tab width.

name: fixedWidth
label: Span tabs
description: Option to space the tabs evenly to fit the full width of the component.

name: spaceBetweenItems
label: Space between items
description: Option to set the space between the tabs.

name: enableCollapsing
label: Allow user to collapse tabs
description: Sets whether a user can collapse the content in a selected tab by clicking the tab icon.

name: initiallyCollapsed
label: Collapse tabs by default
description: Sets whether to collapse all tab content when the page first loads.

name: hideLabel
label: Hide tab labels
description: Option to hide the labels of the tabs. Tab icons still show even if you select to hide tab labels. To make a tab completely blank, remove the tab icon also.

name: showInlinePadding
label: Show inline padding
description: Option to add additional inline padding to vertical tab buttons.

name: position
label: Tab position
description: Option to position tabs on top, the left, or the right of the content.

name: size
label: Label size
description: Sets the size of the tab labels.

name: ariaLabel
label: Aria label
description: The ARIA label is the text a screen reader says out loud to identify the component to users. A good label is simple and clear.

name: hidePadding
label: Hide Padding
description: Set this flag to display each tab with no left or right padding.
